sentences.cn_text: 首要且更为重要的是消费者日益偏好外出就餐：在家庭以外场所消费食品饮料的比例已从1995年约占总消费的32%上升至2000年的35%，预计到2005年将接近38%。
sentences.en_text: The first and more important is the consumer’s growing preference for eating out: the consumption of food and drink in places other than homes has risen from about 32 percent of total consumption in 1995 to 35 percent in 2000 and is expected to approach 38 percent by 2005.

sentences.cn_text: 这一发展态势推动整个欧洲食品服务领域的批发需求年增长率达到4%至5%，相比之下零售需求的增长率仅为1%至2%。
sentences.en_text: This development is boosting wholesale demand from the food service segment by 4 to 5 percent a year across Europe, compared with growth in retail demand of 1 to 2 percent.

sentences.cn_text: 与此同时，随着经济衰退阴霾日益笼罩，人们愈发焦虑不安。
sentences.en_text: Meanwhile, as the recession is looming large, people are getting anxious.

sentences.cn_text: 他们倾向于更加紧缩开支，并将居家用餐视为切实可行的替代选择。
sentences.en_text: They tend to keep a tighter hold on their purse and consider eating at home a realistic alternative.

sentences.cn_text: 欧洲主要市场的食品饮料零售销售陷入停滞，致使欧洲杂货零售商急切寻求增长机遇。
sentences.en_text: Retail sales of food and drink in Europe’s largest markets are at a standstill, leaving European grocery retailers hungry for opportunities to grow.

sentences.cn_text: 多数领先零售商已尝试电子商务但成效有限，并尝试海外扩张。
sentences.en_text: Most leading retailers have already tried e-commerce, with limited success, and expansion abroad.

sentences.cn_text: 但几乎所有零售商都忽视了近在眼前的巨大盈利机会：食品饮料批发贸易，这恰恰是零售商所需的那类市场。
sentences.en_text: But almost all have ignored the big, profitable opportunity in their own backyard: the wholesale food and drink trade, which appears to be just the kind of market retailers need.

sentences.cn_text: 此类波动会引发食品饮料市场整体结构的变革吗？
sentences.en_text: Will such variations bring about a change in the overall structure of the food and drink market?

sentences.cn_text: 绝对不会。
sentences.en_text: Definitely not.

sentences.cn_text: 市场运作基于潜在买方主导的灵活趋势。
sentences.en_text: The functioning of the market is based on flexible trends dominated by potential buyers.

sentences.cn_text: 换言之，决定购买何物的是买方而非卖方。
sentences.en_text: In other words, it is up to the buyer, rather than the seller, to decide what to buy.

sentences.cn_text: 无论当前消费模式持续多久，这种变化终将获得日益增多的国内外消费者的认可。
sentences.en_text: At any rate, this change will ultimately be acclaimed by an ever- growing number of both domestic and international consumers, regardless of how long the current consumer pattern will take hold.

sentences.cn_text: 总而言之，这显然是一个大型零售商可充分发挥其庞大规模、既有基础设施以及在产品组合管理、物流和市场情报方面成熟技能以获取利润的市场。
sentences.en_text: All in all, this clearly seems to be a market in which big retailers could profitably apply their gigantic scale, existing infrastructure, and proven skills in the management of product ranges, logistics, and marketing intelligence.

sentences.cn_text: 精通欧洲批发业务复杂性的零售商完全有望借此获得丰厚利润。
sentences.en_text: Retailers that master the intricacies of wholesaling in Europe may well expect to rake in substantial profits thereby.

sentences.cn_text: 至少从整体上看是如此。
sentences.en_text: At least, that is how it looks as a whole.

sentences.cn_text: 细致考察则会发现各主要国家市场之间存在重大差异，尤其体现在客户细分、批发结构以及各类食品饮料的竞争态势方面。
sentences.en_text: Closer inspection reveals important differences among the biggest national markets, especially in their customer segments and wholesale structures, as well as the competitive dynamics of individual food and drink categories.

sentences.cn_text: 大型零售商必须理解这些差异，才能识别出欧洲批发业中哪些细分领域可凭借其独特优势撼动规模较小却根基牢固的竞争对手。
sentences.en_text: Big retailers must understand these differences before they can identify the segments of European wholesaling in which their particular abilities might unseat smaller but entrenched competitors.

sentences.cn_text: 同时还需要掌握新技能和陌生的商业模式。
sentences.en_text: New skills and unfamiliar business models are needed too.

sentences.cn_text: 尽管细节有别，经深入考察的法国、德国、意大利和西班牙等国的批发市场均由相同的构成要素组成。
sentences.en_text: Despite variations in detail, wholesale markets in the countries that have been closely examined — France, Germany, Italy and Spain — are made out of the same building blocks.

sentences.cn_text: 需求主要源于两类：一是独立经营的夫妻杂货店，这类店铺不同于大型零售连锁，规模不足以直接向生产商采购；二是面向消费者提供外出用餐服务的食品服务运营商。
sentences.en_text: Demand comes mainly from two sources: independent mom-and-pop grocery stores which, unlike large retail chains, are too small to buy straight from producers, and food service operators that cater to consumers when they don’t eat at home.

sentences.cn_text: 此类食品服务运营商涵盖从自动售货机到大型机构餐饮企业等各种形式，但其中大部分在业内被统称为「horeca」：酒店、餐厅和咖啡馆。
sentences.en_text: Such food service operators range from snack machines to large institutional catering ventures, but most of these businesses are known in the trade as “horeca”: hotels, restaurants and cafés.

sentences.cn_text: 总体而言，欧洲食品饮料批发市场的增长速度与零售市场同样缓慢，但这些数据汇总后掩盖了两种对立趋势。
sentences.en_text: Overall, Europe’s wholesale market for food and drink is growing at the same sluggish pace as the retail market, but the figures, when added together, mask two opposing trends.

sentences.cn_text: 例如，2000年法国、德国、意大利、西班牙和英国的食品饮料批发销售额达2680亿美元，超过零售额的40%。
sentences.en_text: For example, wholesale food and drink sales came to $268 billion in France, Germany, Italy, Spain, and the United Kingdom in 2000 — more than 40 percent of retail sales.

sentences.cn_text: 此外，批发的整体平均利润率高于零售；随着更多欧洲人更频繁外出就餐，食品服务领域对批发的需求快速增长；而这一分散行业竞争格局的变化终于使批发商整合成为可能。
sentences.en_text: Moreover, average overall margins are higher in wholesale than in retail; wholesale demand from the food service sector is growing quickly as more Europeans eat out more often; and changes in the competitive dynamics of this fragmented industry are at last making it feasible for wholesalers to consolidate.

sentences.cn_text: 然而，这些要求均不应阻止大型零售商（乃至部分大型食品生产商和现有批发商）一试身手，因为那些精通欧洲批发业复杂性的企业将获得可观收益。
sentences.en_text: However, none of these requirements should deter large retailers (and even some large food producers and existing wholesalers) from trying their hand, for those that master the intricacies of wholesaling in Europe stand to reap considerable gains.
